div.head: A database of the law codes of pre-Conquest England
div.p: eLiebermann's lawcodes database brings together the law codes of England before the Norman Conquest. The database contains the Old English text, as printed in Felix Liebermann's Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, with Liebermann's German translation and a literal English rendering of his translation. Other editions and translations are provided where available.
Every clause is also indexed by subject, so the laws can be searched by the people, offences, places and topics they deal with.

div.head: An online dictionary of pre-Conquest English law
div.p: eLiebermann is a digital edition of the Wörterbuch, the dictionary in Volume II of Felix Liebermann's Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, the standard edition of the laws of England before the Norman Conquest. This dictionary covers the Old English, Latin and French words of the law codes and certain related texts. This digital version links to the law-code clauses in which each word appears, and to explanations and translations of Liebermann's abbreviations and sigla.
